en.html:
For the time being, Fudaraku Castle still stood.
The occupation forces stopped attacking at sunset and pulled back toward the coast.

Some of the Horigoe staff proposed pursuit. Probably this was a little encouragement for the room; I doubted anybody really thought we could do it. At the Fujisawa approach, over one in ten defenders had been killed or wounded.

A serious loss. No improvement was available by choosing a happier word.

ひとまずのところ、普陀楽城は健在であった。
　進駐軍は日没に合わせて攻撃を停止し、海岸方面へ
撤収していった。

　堀越領衆の幕僚団からは追撃の意見具申もあったが、
おそらく一種の<ruby>景気付け<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>のようなもので、本当は誰も
そんな事ができるなどと考えてはいなかったろう。
　藤沢口守備隊の死傷率は一割を超えている。

　深刻な被害と言わざるを得なかった。

en.html:
I had stopped walking. Chachamaru asked what was wrong.

The hurried movements outside had caught my eye.

Wounded men carried on stretchers.
A soldier with one leg missing, on a comrade's back, heading for the medical station. Perhaps waiting for proper transport was more time than he had.

Things on stretchers that did not move.
Something else by the roadside, also no longer moving. Nobody noticed him. Or everyone noticed. Either way, there he remained, discarded...

en.html:
Doushin"Oyumi Palace appears to have fallen. An urgent report came a little earlier."
Raichou"...I see."
Raichou"Lord Doushin, I am sorry. As the lord entrusted with Oyumi, I must offer my apologies."
Doushin"No, no, do not bow your head. Oyumi could not be helped. You were fighting with all your strength here at Fudaraku."
Chachamaru"Arre, we knew from the start. If the occupation army got the first move, Oyumi would fall easily. Good place to attack from, bloody useless place to defend."
Doushin"Quite so, quite so. Lord Raichou, do not burden yourself with it. The enemy in front of us requires our attention now."
Raichou"...Yes..."
Chachamaru"Doushin bhai, heard anything from Shishiku?"
Doushin"Nothing. The enemy's signal jamming seems especially severe toward the northeast."
Chachamaru"Achha... Never mind. He's probably only just reaching Sasagawa territory, if he's reached it at all."
Doushin"Two more days... no, three. We shall have to endure at least that."
Chachamaru"Even three days is a difficult business. Two difficulties, actually."
Raichou"Can Shishiku bring reinforcements in three days? Can Fudaraku hold for another three days?"
Raichou"...Those two?"
Chachamaru"Haan."
Raichou"Yes..."
Doushin"The Oyumi contingent at Oofuna, and Horigoe at Fujisawa. How do your troops stand?"
Raichou"The picture is not a cheerful one."
Chachamaru"Mine also. One day, and they've scraped us down properly."
Chachamaru"Can you send some of the reserves our way? Otherwise tomorrow we won't hold."
Doushin"Understood. I shall make the arrangements shortly."

ja.html:
童心「小弓御所は陥ちた様子でござる。 　先刻、急報があり申した」
雷蝶「……そうですか」
雷蝶「童心様、申し訳ございません。 　小弓を預かる公方としてお詫びいたします」
童心「いやいや、頭などお下げになるな。 　小弓の件は致し方なき事。雷蝶殿は普陀楽 で奮闘しておられたのだからのう」
茶々丸「進駐軍に先手を打たれたら小弓はあっさり 陥ちるって、最初からわかってたじゃねえか。 　攻めるにはいいけど守るにはてんで不向き だからな、あそこ」
童心「さようさよう。 　雷蝶殿、気に病まれてはなりませぬぞ。今 は目の前の敵に集中せねば」
雷蝶「……ええ……」
茶々丸「童心坊主、獅子吼からの連絡はあった？」
童心「ござらぬ。 　敵の信号妨害が特に北東方面は厳しいよう でござっての」
茶々丸「そーかぁ……。 　まぁいいや。どうせまだ篠川領に入ったか どうかってところだろうしな」
童心「あと二日…… 　いや三日は耐えねばなりますまい」
茶々丸「三日と見ても、厳しいところだな。 　二重の意味で」
雷蝶「三日で獅子吼が援軍に来られるか。 　あと三日、普陀楽を守り抜けるか」
雷蝶「……ということ？」
茶々丸「うん」
雷蝶「そうね……」
童心「大船口の小弓、藤沢口の堀越、両御領衆の 状況は如何でござる？」
雷蝶「あまり明るくはありません」
茶々丸「うちも。 　今日一日でガリガリ削られましたよ」
茶々丸「予備隊を一部回してくれない？ 　でないと明日はもう保たねえわ」
童心「承知いたした。 　後程、取り計らいましょうぞ」

en.html:
Chachamaru"...They've pulled back on the ground. But the bombing from above, looks like that's doing the full night shift."
Doushin"Even dropping blindly in the dark, aim for the castle's center and something will be hit. Direct results may not amount to much, but merely keeping us from sleep is purpose enough."
Chachamaru"What a fucking nuisance. Show some laziness, yaar. Thoda toh!"
Raichou"Why not say it loudly enough for THEM to hear?"
Chachamaru"What, ask nicely? If 'please stop' got us an 'okay,' bhai, we wouldn't be having a fucking war in the first place."
Doushin"Huh-huh... quite, quite. I have one thought rather better than that. Would you hear it?"
Raichou"What is it?"
Doushin"Oh, nothing elaborate. I merely thought: taking a beating without returning any gets rather dull."
Chachamaru"...Now you're talking. But whose troops are you sending?"
Chachamaru"My Horigoe contingent has nothing to spare. The reserves?"
Doushin"No, no. The reserves must be used with care."
Doushin"There are others much better suited to this work."
Chachamaru"...Ah. Haan. There are."
Kageaki"————"

茶々丸「…………。 　陸の上は退いたが、空からの爆撃は夜通し やるつもりらしいな」
童心「闇の中の盲撃ちでも、城の中心部を狙って 落とせば何処かには当たるからのう。 　直接の戦果はさほど期待できずとも、我ら の眠りを妨げるだけで充分に意味はあり申す」
茶々丸「迷惑な話だ。 　ちっとは手ぇ抜けよ」
雷蝶「向こうに聴こえるように言ったら？」
茶々丸「お願いしろってか。 　それでオッケーもらえるようなら最初から 戦争なんてやってねえよ、あてら」
童心「ふっふぅ……まったくまったく。 　それよりはましな思案がひとつござるが、 お聞き頂けますかな」
雷蝶「何でしょう？」
童心「や、なに。 　やられっ放しでいるのもつまらなかろうと、 それだけのことでござるよ」
茶々丸「…………そりゃ上等だ。 　でも、どの兵を動かす？」
茶々丸「堀越領衆こっちにはそんな余裕ねーぞ。 　予備隊か？」
童心「いやいや。 　予備隊は慎重に使わねばなりますまい」
童心「もっと適した者どもがおり申す」
茶々丸「……あぁ。そうか。 　いたな」
景明「――――」

Chachamaru glanced back at me—no, farther behind me.
Having an inkling myself, I looked that way at the same moment.

...Not a sound. Not even the air disturbed.
The man had apparently been waiting there. Since when, no announcement had been made.
